todayExpenses.description: Σ ACTIVE expenses dated today, in PAISA.

amount.description: Cash the owner takes out of the shop, in PAISA. Rs 50,000 = 5000000. Must be greater than zero.

confirmOverdraft.description: Send true to accept that this withdrawal takes the drawer below zero. Without it the request answers 200 with the shortfall and writes nothing.

returnAmount.description: Value of this return in PAISA: Σ quantity × unitPrice minus this return's pro-rata share of the sale discount. Computed by the server, never sent.

outstandingBefore.description: What the customer still owes on this sale right now, in PAISA (total − returns − active payments + refunds).

outstandingAfter.description: Outstanding once this return is saved, in PAISA.

refundable.description: Maximum cash that can be refunded with this return, in PAISA: the return value minus the Udhar it cancels, capped by what was actually paid (minus earlier refunds).

refundAmount.description: The refundAmount you sent, in PAISA. 0 = keep it all as Udhar relief.

quantity.description: How many units of this line are returned. REQUIRED on quantity-tracked lines; omit (or send 1) on a phone line — one IMEI is one unit.

condition.description: GOOD goes back on the shelf and becomes sellable again. DAMAGED does not — it is taken back off the shelf immediately (phones become DAMAGED units, accessories get a write-off movement).

items.description: Lines being returned — identical to what you would POST to save.

refundAmount.description: Refund you are considering, in PAISA, to preview its cash effect.

returnDate.description: Business day of the return, as YYYY-MM-DD. The refund (if any) is recorded on the same day.

items.description: Lines being returned. At least one. Each line names its sale line and the condition it comes back in.

refundAmount.description: Cash given back now, in PAISA. 0 (or omit) keeps the whole return value against the sale's Udhar. Cannot exceed what is refundable: the return value first cancels the outstanding Udhar, and only the already-paid remainder can leave the drawer.

confirmOverdraft.description: Send true to retry after the "cash below zero" warning. Only needed when refundAmount would take the drawer negative.

countedCash.description: Real cash physically counted in the drawer, in PAISA. Rs 478,500 = 47850000. Zero is legal (an empty drawer).

reason.description: Required ONLY when countedCash differs from the system cash. Stored so the difference can be explained later.

systemCash.description: System cash = SUM(IN) − SUM(OUT), in paisa.

countedCash.description: Cash the owner counted, in paisa.

difference.description: counted − system, in paisa. Sign shows direction.

paid.description: Σ ACTIVE supplier payments against this bill (paisa).

grossSales.description: Total value of goods handed out (paisa).

cogs.description: Σ unitCost × qty over the period’s ACTIVE sales (paisa).

returns.description: Σ returnAmount of ACTIVE returns in the period (paisa).

expenses.description: Σ amount of ACTIVE expenses in the period (paisa).

netProfit.description: grossSales − cogs − returns − expenses (paisa). May be negative.

salesCount.description: Number of ACTIVE sales in the period.

refunds.description: Σ refund amounts on ACTIVE returns (paisa).

outstanding.description: opening + bought − paid − returns + refunds (paisa). What the customer owes right now.

overdue.description: Σ over ACTIVE sales with a past dueDate of their unpaid part (paisa).

lastSaleDate.description: Business day of the latest ACTIVE sale.

payable.description: opening + bought − paid (paisa). What the shop owes this supplier.

lastPurchaseDate.description: Business day of the latest ACTIVE purchase.

inStock.description: quantityOnHand for QUANTITY; count of IN_STOCK units for SERIALIZED.

stockValue.description: qty × avgUnitCost for QUANTITY; Σ unitCost of IN_STOCK units for SERIALIZED (paisa).

revenue.description: Σ line totals over the period’s ACTIVE sales (paisa).
